dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity transitions, characterized by high-intensity (white/light gray) perimeters with jagged edges enclosing low-intensity (dark charcoal) interiors. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters located within the broader light-intensity networked region on the lower-lateral flank. Core pixel concentrations are asymmetrical and lack internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary triad of prominent ring centroids in the dorsal-mid region forms a scalene triangle. These points connect to a secondary cluster of high-intensity blobs in the lower-mid region, creating a complex polygonal network.
